texts: bad: "cannot ... exactly" makes the negation swallow the whole counting event, so the parse says the keepers cannot count the sky-cats at all; the point of the sentence (they can count them, just not precisely) is lost, and the inability is recorded only of the keepers as a body rather than of each keeper. Split the two claims into plain finite clauses, one thing each: "The keepers can count the sky-cats, but they cannot give an exact number."
